chunks: Ali ibn Ahmad narrated to us, from Ubaydillah ibn Musa al-Alawi, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Qalanisi, from Muhammad ibn Ali, from Abu Jameela, from Abu Bakr al-Hadhrami, who said:
We do not time this matter.

key_terms.إِنَّا: We (referring to the Prophet's progeny/Ahl al-Bayt)
key_terms.الْأَمْرَ: The matter / The event (referring to the appearance of the Mahdi)
key_terms.نُوَقِّتُ: We time / We assign a specific time

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about timing the appearance of the Mahdi?
ai.summary: In the context of the major occultation (al-Ghayba al-Kubra), Imam al-Sadiq clarifies that the Ahl al-Bayt do not fix a specific date or year for the rise of al-Qa'im, distinguishing their stance from those who speculated on precise timings. This hadith underscores the principle of 'la ta'teer' (not assigning a time) to preserve the authenticity of the Imamate against the claims of various sects during the period of the Twelve Imams.
